observations: A solid black figure with long upright ears sits cross-legged on a flat black ground strip; its face carries two X marks for eyes and a stitched-line mouth.
Yellow lines radiate outward from behind the figure's head in two distinct types: tight vertical zigzags near the top and looser horizontal waves spreading left and right.
The background is a single flat deep-red field filling the entire space above the ground strip, with no gradation or secondary shapes.
reading: The figure sits still while the lines around it vibrate outward in two ways — sharp jolts above, slower waves to the sides. That contrast between a motionless body and agitated surroundings gives the image its tension. The X eyes and sewn mouth read as blankness rather than expression, which makes the radiating energy feel external, something pressing in rather than coming out.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the immediate title neighbors share the same flat ground strip, X-eyed figure, and radiating-line halo. The collector links this visual shorthand — flat silhouette, emanating marks — to the incised line patterns of scrimshaw.
